edges.reason: msg.sender is used in the constructor to seed the owner and initial reflection balance
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of the token movement
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for the allowance check
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner
_transfer receives the caller-derived from address
manualswap authorizes based on msg.sender equalling _FeeAddress
manualsend authorizes based on msg.sender equalling _FeeAddress
cooldown entries are written using block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependency
_transfer enforces cooldown[to] < block.timestamp and writes block.timestamp + 30 seconds
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline
_transfer reads and updates the cooldown mapping keyed by timestamp
_transfer rewrites the _taxFee state variable
_transfer rewrites the _teamFee state variable
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide fee exemption
_transfer checks bots[from] and bots[to] before allowing the transfer
_transfer compares from/to against the uniswap pair address
_transfer gates the auto-swap on the inSwap flag
_transfer gates the auto-swap on the swapEnabled flag
_transfer gates the cooldown logic on cooldownEnabled
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount
_transferStandard reads and writes _rOwned for sender and recipient
_takeTeam credits the team reflection amount into _rOwned of the contract
_reflectFee subtracts the rFee from _rTotal
_reflectFee adds the tFee to _tFeeTotal
sendETHToFee pays half the ETH to _FeeAddress
sendETHToFee pays half the ETH to _marketingWalletAddress
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router for the swap and WETH path
openTrading assigns the router instance to uniswapV2Router
openTrading assigns the created pair to uniswapV2Pair
setBots writes true into the bots mapping
delBot writes false into the bots mapping
setMaxTx updates _maxTxAmount
setCooldownEnabled updates the cooldownEnabled flag
owner returns the _owner state variable
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address
_transfer branches on from != owner() and to != owner() to bypass fee and bot checks
transfer delegates execution to _transfer
transferFrom delegates execution to _transfer
The constructor establishes the owner later returned by owner()
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer with the takeFee decision
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to perform the balance movement
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team cut
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the reflection cut
_transfer performs an external swap via swapTokensForEth before finalizing the user transfer, enabling state-race reentrancy
_transfer sends ETH to external wallets before completing its own accounting
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the whole contract balance
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the whole contract ETH balance
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call, an interaction point for reentry
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to the fee and marketing wallets
openTrading performs the payable addLiquidityETH external call
openTrading calls the factory to create the pair
openTrading approves the pair for the maximum uint amount
_transferStandard relies on add/sub arithmetic for reflection balances
_takeTeam relies on mul/add arithmetic for the team reflection amount
The external router swap can re-enter the contract through the token transfer path before state is settled
The external router swap callback can reenter _transfer while inSwap logic is executing

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only feeds the _transfer logic and carries no standalone semantics
The to parameter is only meaningful inside the _transfer checks and accounting
The amount parameter is consumed entirely by _transfer for limits and value computation
The local contract token balance is derived and used exclusively inside _transfer
The reflection rate local is computed from the supply helpers invoked by _transferStandard
The sender parameter is only forwarded along the _tokenTransfer call chain
The recipient parameter is only forwarded along the _tokenTransfer call chain
The token amount parameter is decomposed by _getValues inside _transferStandard
The swap path array exists only for the router swap invoked by swapTokensForEth
The bot address array is iterated and written to state only within setBots
The loop index is a purely local construct of the setBots iteration
The new maximum amount value is validated and stored only in setMaxTx
The address argument is only used to unmark a single entry in the bots mapping
